name: St. Genesius
bio:
Genesius was a Roman actor in the late third century, during the reign of Emperor Diocletian. According to tradition, he led a troupe of actors who performed satirical plays mocking the Christian faith.

While performing a mock baptism before the emperor, Genesius was suddenly converted. He stopped the play, declared himself a Christian, and refused to renounce his new faith.

Diocletian ordered him tortured and beheaded around the year 303. He is remembered as the patron saint of actors, comedians, and those who work in the theater.

prayer.text: O God, who converted St. Genesius in the middle of a mock baptism before the emperor and gave him the crown of martyrdom, grant through his intercession that actors and all who work in the arts may make their craft serve the truth. We ask this through Christ our Lord. Amen.
